name: text-to-speech-api
title: Text to Speech API - Neural Voices, No API Key
description: Most text to speech actors cannot run without your own API key, and they bill every character they read. This one speaks inside the run: neural voices are baked into the image, no key is asked, and you pay only for a clip you can download.

meta.memoryJustification: Piper runs an ONNX voice model and onnxruntime needs about 700 MB for a medium voice; 1024 MB is the smallest size that holds one voice plus the audio buffers of a batch.
